title: Ring of Fear
summary: Interrupt the sacrifice, survive the temple waves and face the avatars of fear.
overview: Interrupt the sacrifice, survive the temple waves and face the avatars of fear.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Engaging the high priest draws his guards into combat.
After the priest falls, the linked sequence escalates through waves and the Avatars of Dread, Fright and Terror.
Keep resources for the Avatar of Fear when the final stage becomes attackable.
Finish the final avatar within its thirty-minute window.
